description: Rotary, inverter and reciprocating compressors from other makers for split, window and light commercial ACs. Exact models are matched to your unit.

series.name: Rotary compressors
series.brands: GMCC, Highly, LG, Panasonic and others
series.description: Fixed-speed rotary compressors for split and window ACs. We match the replacement to your AC's capacity, refrigerant and the original compressor's mounting and electrical ratings.
features: Compact, quiet and efficient at small capacities
Matched to the original refrigerant, capacity and mounting
Usually supplied with a matching run capacitor where needed

series.name: Inverter (BLDC) compressors
series.brands: GMCC, Highly, LG, Panasonic and others
series.description: Variable-speed brushless DC compressors for inverter split ACs. These must be matched to the outdoor PCB's drive, so we confirm the exact model from your old compressor's label.
power_supply: Driven by the outdoor unit's inverter PCB
features: Speed varies with load for lower power use
Must match the inverter drive on the outdoor PCB
Replacement identified from the original compressor label

series.name: Reciprocating compressors
series.application: Older ACs, water coolers and light commercial units
series.description: Reciprocating compressors for older ACs and light commercial cooling equipment. We match capacity, refrigerant and mounting to the original unit.
features: Suited to older and light commercial equipment
Matched to the original refrigerant and mounting
